title: Agora serves the trader's shadow comparison on an owner-scoped Agora route

design.owner: TradingRoomService.decision_lock_owner, the one instance composed in create_agora_router and shared with the Management shadow route (BFF-ATTRIBUTION-SHADOW-OWNER-WIRING-20261122, #7743); no second owner or default substitute (unconfigured owner answers 503 decision_lock_owner_unavailable)
design.ownership: lock tenant_id and user_id must equal the caller's canonical Agora scope; read_all roles (operator) are not widened here
design.non_enumeration: foreign lock, other tenant, operator and unknown id all answer 404 reason decision_not_found; attribution owner is not called
design.empty_state: caller's own event with no lock answers 200 status empty, comparison_state no_decision_recorded
design.management_route: unchanged; shape_shadow defaults keep trader/institutional_view naming and operator audience
design.runtime_budget: reads only: one lock read, one attribution GET; no writes, no new store
